description: Trash up to 200 items (drive_restore recovers). Without confirmed: plan and problems only. With confirmed=true: trashes only if no problems. With confirmed=true the server first asks the user to approve the exact list, and trashes nothing if the plan changed meanwhile.

confirmed.description: Plan/apply switch: false or absent returns the plan only and changes nothing; true applies it after the server has asked the user to approve the exact list.

name: drive_bulk_trash
title: Trash many items
